why: A Journal of Translational Medicine letter: seven paragraphs directly in <body> with no section and no abstract, followed by Europe PMC's back matter placed inside <body> as titled <sec>s (acknowledgements, author contributions, funding, data availability, a Declarations section with three subsections, a footnote group, the reference list). Pins the letter as one untitled body section, each back section and the nested declarations under their own headings, the footnote group's wrapper not rendered as a section, and the no-abstract warning.
